evidence.title: NTSB: Warning horns sounded before deadly LA news helicopter crash

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and flight-tracking data
occurrences.quote_span: The last data point showed the aircraft descending at a high rate, traveling about 38 knots ground speed directly above the crash site.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: Security camera footage and crash scene records
occurrences.quote_span: Security cameras from nearby buildings recorded the helicopter descending rapidly before it struck a metal storage container and burst into flames.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report flight track and timeline
occurrences.quote_span: The aircraft then spent about an hour and 24 minutes maneuvering in the vicinity of the bus crash before it went down.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report flight data
occurrences.quote_span: During the final minute of the flight, the helicopter was roughly 800 feet above the ground and decelerated to about six knots ground speed, according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and flight-tracking data
occurrences.quote_span: At about 6:55 p.m. local time on Sept. 15, flight-tracking data showed the helicopter "began a rapid descent while turning right," according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report on the NewsChopper4 crash
occurrences.quote_span: Warning horns sounded inside a news helicopter in the final seconds before it crashed into a Los Angeles County neighborhood last month, killing three people, according to a preliminary federal report released Oct. 6.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and wreckage examination records
occurrences.quote_span: A post-crash examination found that all major components remained attached to the fuselage or were located within a debris field extending about 30 feet from the wreckage, according to the report.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB wreckage custody and examination records
occurrences.quote_span: The helicopter was later moved to a facility for further examination.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and crash scene records
occurrences.quote_span: A postaccident fire quickly ensued," the report states.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and NTSB investigation status
occurrences.quote_span: While the preliminary report did not determine what caused the helicopter to crash, it provided new details about the aircraft's final moments that investigators are examining as part of the ongoing investigation.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and onboard video
occurrences.quote_span: Investigators reviewed a four-minute, 21-second video recorded by the onboard reporter and found that "ambient helicopter noise" was consistent with normal operations for most of the recording.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report flight history
occurrences.quote_span: In its preliminary report, the National Transportation Safety Board said the helicopter departed Whiteman Airport and flew to Chatsworth to gather video footage of the fatal bus crash.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and onboard video audio
occurrences.quote_span: Investigators also noted that the helicopter noise changed frequency during those last seconds.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth

occurrences.checkable_against: NTSB preliminary report and onboard video audio
occurrences.quote_span: But in the final 29 seconds, the recording captured changing engine and rotor sounds along with "intermittent and continuous horns" consistent with the helicopter's "main rotor high rpm, low rotor rpm and other aural advisories," the report states.
occurrences.speaker: National Transportation Safety Board
occurrences.subject: NTSB investigation of NewsChopper4 helicopter crash near Chatsworth
